# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.3

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently
> unavailable.

## Fixes

- Fix the Update Center binding loop
- Stop video and screenshot thumbnails from flickering
- Restore outside-click dismissal for all pickers
- Add mouse-wheel navigation to all pickers
- Restore widget loading for fallback hosts
- Make release checksums consistent across Python runner versions

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.0...v0.1.1-beta.3`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1-beta.3)
